test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Most of the standard Harappan seals were made of _______, a kind of soft stone that was square in shape with a 2 × 2 dimension and was used for commercial purposes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Steatite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Standard Harappan seals**

 
 
• The **Indus Valley Civilization** created several artefacts and works of literature.
 
• During the second half of the **third millennium BCE**, the **Indus Valley art form emerged** (i.e. from 2500 BC onwards).
 
• Archaeologists have found** thousands of seals **in the Harappan sites.
 
• **Steatite**, a soft stone, was used to create the majority of the seals.
 
• Some of them were additionally constructed from **gold, terracotta, chert, ivory, faience, and agate**.
 
• The standard Harappan seal had a **2X2 dimension and was square in shape**. 
 
• Every seal has a **drawing of an animal** and **writing in pictographic character**.
 
• Primarily, **tigers, elephants, bulls, bison, goats**, and other animals are represented.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The majority of seals have **writing on both sides**.
 
• The writings have a **Kharosthi aesthetic** (right to left). 
 
• The **Pashupati Seal** of the Harappan civilization from **Mohenjo Daro** is the most well-known seal. 
 
• An **elephant, a tiger, a rhino, and a buffalo** are positioned to the **right and left of the figure**, which is seated cross-legged, in the centre of the seal, respectively.
 
• **Various uses of the seal**
 
 
• The seals are thought to have been used for **commercial purposes**.
 
• A few seals were also worn as amulets, possibly serving as a kind of **identification**.
 
• Some seals must have been used for **educational purposes** because they contain mathematical symbols.
